bio.text: Löki Tobin, a Democrat, has represented District I in the Alaska Senate since 2023.

Her legislative biography says Tobin was born and raised in Nome, is a University of Alaska Anchorage graduate, and holds a master's degree in rural development from the University of Alaska Fairbanks Peace Corps Master's International Program.

She served as a Peace Corps youth development volunteer in Azerbaijan from 2008 to 2011, worked in marketing and communications for Alaska nonprofits, and was policy director for state Sen. Tom Begich, according to the biography.
